topStories.headline: June PCE Inflation Cools for First Time in Six Years, Giving Markets a Relief Valve
topStories.summary: The BEA's June Personal Consumption Expenditures report showed headline PCE fell 0.1% month-on-month — the first monthly decline in six years — while the annual rate came in at 3.7% and core PCE rose just 0.1% MoM (+3.3% YoY), helping underpin Thursday's broad market recovery.
topStories.marketImpact: Bonds stabilised; equities ↑ on Fed dovish-pivot optionality; PCE still well above 2% target, limiting market euphoria

topStories.headline: Amazon Posts First-Ever $200B Quarter; AWS Grows 37% at Fastest Rate in 18 Quarters
topStories.summary: Amazon's Q2 2026 net sales reached $200.6B (+20% YoY) with AWS revenue surging 37% to $42.2B driven by AI infrastructure demand; AWS operating income hit $16.6B at a 39% margin; advertising grew 26% to $19.8B.
topStories.marketImpact: AMZN ↑9% post-market; AWS growth validates the AI cloud capex supercycle and anchors Thursday's rally ↑

topStories.headline: Apple Q3 Revenue Hits Record $109.4B with iPhone +22%, but Services Miss Weighs on Shares
topStories.summary: Apple reported FY Q3 revenue of $109.4B (+16% YoY) and EPS of $2.02 (+29%), with iPhone up 22%, but services revenue of $30.74B came in below the $31.22B consensus, sending shares down 3–4% after hours.
topStories.marketImpact: AAPL ↓3–4% after-hours; services deceleration risk to premium valuation at $5T market cap ↓

topStories.headline: Microsoft Cloud and AI Strength Fuels Record $90B Quarter, Leads Tech Recovery
topStories.summary: Microsoft Q4 FY2026 revenue hit $90B (+18%) with operating income of $40.6B (+18%) and net income of $35.8B (+31%), driven by Azure and Copilot AI products; full-year revenue reached $331.8B.
topStories.marketImpact: MSFT ↑ leading Thursday's tech recovery rally; Azure and AI backlog growth reassures cloud spend thesis ↑

topStories.headline: Meta Revenue Surges 28% to $60.8B but EPS Misses Badly as AI Capex Doubles to $31B per Quarter
topStories.summary: Meta's Q2 revenue of $60.8B (+28%) beat estimates, but EPS of $6.18 missed $7.17 consensus by 14% as capital expenditure hit $31.1B in a single quarter — more than double a year ago — collapsing free cash flow to $784M.
topStories.marketImpact: META ↓ ~5%; AI capex sustainability and FCF destruction are the central investor debate for mega-cap tech ↓

topStories.headline: BOJ Holds at 1% with Lone Dissent as Japan and US Conduct Coordinated Yen Intervention
topStories.summary: The Bank of Japan kept its policy rate at 1% (8-1 vote, with Hajime Takata dissenting for a hike to 1.25%) while warning underlying inflation may exceed 2%; Japan and the US conducted coordinated yen-buying/dollar-selling intervention, driving USD/JPY from the 162 range to as low as 157–158.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY ↑3.3% vs USD; Toyota, Honda ↓ on yen strength; Nikkei 225 ↑600+ pts on US tech tailwinds offsetting FX headwinds

topStories.headline: Japan Carries Out Massive Yen-Buying Intervention in New York, US Executes Rate Check
topStories.summary: Japan conducted massive yen-buying, dollar-selling intervention in New York markets with US authorities simultaneously executing rate checks, in a coordinated effort that drove the yen to as strong as 157 per dollar from above 162, its biggest single-day move in years.
topStories.marketImpact: USD/JPY ↓2.6% to ~159; export-oriented Japanese stocks under pressure; Nikkei absorbs yen impact via semiconductor gains ↑

topStories.headline: US Strikes Iran as Conflict Escalates; Saudi Arabia Proposes Naval Coalition to Protect Hormuz
topStories.summary: US forces conducted a heavy wave of retaliatory strikes against Iran on July 29 after Iranian ballistic missiles targeting US troops were intercepted; Iran threatens further response while Saudi Arabia proposes a naval coalition to protect the Strait of Hormuz, tempering oil's spike.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude eased to ~$89 from $90.74 spike; WTI ~$83.59; energy stocks ↑; Hormuz disruption risk remains elevated ↑

topStories.headline: Beijing Says Washington Pledged to Cap New Tariffs on Chinese Goods at 20%
topStories.summary: China's Commerce Ministry disclosed that the US committed during bilateral trade talks to limit replacement tariffs on Chinese goods to a ceiling of 20%; the current replacement tariff stands at 12.5% after new Section 301 levies on July 23.
topStories.marketImpact: Reduced escalation risk provides a near-term floor for Chinese equities; Hang Seng holding ~25,858 ↑

topStories.headline: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index Surges 8%+ as Amazon and Microsoft Capex Validates Chip Demand
topStories.summary: The Philadelphia SOX semiconductor index surged 8.19% Thursday, led by AMD, Nvidia, and Broadcom, as Amazon's AWS blowout and Microsoft's cloud results reaffirmed the AI infrastructure buildout sustaining unprecedented chip demand; Intel's 18A foundry also attracting major customer wins.
topStories.marketImpact: AMD ↑ sharply (up ~150% YTD); NVDA ↑; AVGO ↑; INTC ↑; entire AI chip supply chain re-rated upward ↑
